definitions.explanation: Remaining awake throughout the night, typically for work or study.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{前|まえ}に{徹夜|てつや}した。
examples.english: I pulled an all-nighter before the exam.

examples.japanese: {徹夜|てつや}で{仕事|しごと}を{終|お}わらせた。
examples.english: I finished the work by staying up all night.

examples.japanese: {徹夜|てつや}は{体|からだ}に{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: Staying up all night is bad for your health.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{徹夜|てつや}する (to stay up all night)
・{徹夜|てつや}で〜する (to do ~ by staying up all night)
・{徹夜|てつや}{明|あ}け (the morning after staying up all night)

COMMON USES:
・{徹夜|てつや}で{勉強|べんきょう}する (to study all night)
・{徹夜|てつや}で{仕事|しごと}する (to work all night)
・{徹夜|てつや}{続|つづ}き (staying up multiple nights in a row)

COLLOQUIAL:
・オール (all-nighter - casual/youth slang from "all-night")
